set.body: Roadmap: bd-01KWWWGMETE2R216KQZWVAJKYV. Scope: modules/group. Acceptance: parameterize GroupData/GroupModel by variance capability so variance-weighted meta-analysis cannot use effects-only data; introduce SubjectAxis and sample-space axes on GroupResponse; type first-level contrast names, design term names, covariates, group contrasts, and sample labels; replace intercept Boolean with InterceptPolicy; add DegreesOfFreedom/PValue constructors for statistics and FDR; structure GroupError payloads. Verification: groupJVM/test and groupJS/test plus fit/group bridge fallout.
set.title: Type group-model axes, variance capability, statistics, and errors
